claims.text: The dataset was created by collecting (speech, transcript, English translation) triplets for five languages, ensuring that only data with valid URLs and CC licenses were included.
Samples with low scores were manually inspected and sent back for translation when needed, ensuring quality control in the dataset.
The dataset includes additional evaluation data derived from Tatoeba, which contributes to its diversity and robustness.
